label: has organizational or political leader
definition: Organization or political body X has person Y holding an explicit managerial or leadership office in it.
scope_notes: Includes: inverse of managerial_office_in with an explicit office; corporate or political institutions; historical office. Excludes: ordinary membership; geographic co-occurrence; interactions without office; forward person-to-body direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: incomplete principal or office attachment. Use only where the prior declaration actually included organizations generally, not to widen a political-only relation.
